opening.argument: The video promotes OneCoin through projected appreciation, anticipated gains, and a direct invitation to pursue profit through a personal account. It calls OneCoin “the most profitable digital pool in the world,” says that a predicted price increase could produce “a great gain,” and invites viewers to build a portfolio and create a profit basis. The offer is framed as a limited opportunity, while a displayed graphic sets out euro-priced trader tiers tied to token quantities and splits. It further asks viewers to participate and supplies email, phone, WhatsApp, and Viber channels for information. These features establish a token-purchase and appreciation pitch, although the available material does not show what contacts would request or establish that viewers paid or received returns.
